terms.objectWithFeatures: Object with at least one feature

INFO_MISSING.message: meta/info.json does not exist or cannot be read
INFO_MISSING.suggestion: Ensure the current directory is the LeRobot dataset root and meta/info.json exists

INFO_PARSE_ERROR.suggestion: Check JSON syntax, e.g. at https://jsonlint.com

VERSION_MISMATCH.suggestion: If this is v3.0, use the correct loader; otherwise set codebase_version to v2.0 or v2.1

TOTAL_EPISODES_INVALID.message: total_episodes must be a positive integer

TOTAL_FRAMES_INVALID.message: total_frames must be a positive integer

TOTAL_TASKS_INVALID.message: total_tasks must be a non-negative integer
TOTAL_TASKS_INVALID.suggestion: Set correct total task count (may be 0)

FPS_INVALID.message: fps must be a positive number

CHUNKS_SIZE_MISSING.message: chunks_size is missing; default 1000 will be used

FEATURES_EMPTY.suggestion: Add features in info.json defining all dataset columns

EPISODES_MISSING.message: meta/episodes.jsonl does not exist or cannot be read
EPISODES_MISSING.suggestion: Create meta/episodes.jsonl with one JSON object per line per episode

EPISODES_INVALID_JSONL.message: A line in episodes.jsonl failed to parse as JSON
EPISODES_INVALID_JSONL.suggestion: Ensure each line is a valid JSON object

EPISODES_COUNT_MISMATCH.message: Parsed episode count ({{parsed}}) does not match total_episodes ({{expected}})
EPISODES_COUNT_MISMATCH.suggestion: Regenerate episodes.jsonl or fix total_episodes in info.json

ZERO_LENGTH_EPISODES.suggestion: Regenerate episodes.jsonl so each episode has a positive frame count

EPISODES_NO_LENGTH.suggestion: Add "length" to each line in episodes.jsonl

TASKS_MISSING.message: meta/tasks.jsonl does not exist or is empty
TASKS_MISSING.suggestion: Create tasks.jsonl with one JSON per line: {"task_index": 0, "task": "description"}

DATA_FILE_MISSING.suggestion: Generate Parquet data files under data/ per v2 format

DATA_FILE_CHECK_FAILED.message: Could not check if data file exists

VIDEO_FILE_CHECK_FAILED.message: Could not check if video file exists

PARQUET_MISSING_COLS.message: Data Parquet is missing required columns: {{cols}}
PARQUET_MISSING_COLS.suggestion: Regenerate data Parquet with system columns

FEATURE_INVALID.message: features.{{key}} is not a valid object
FEATURE_INVALID.suggestion: Ensure each feature is an object with dtype and shape

DTYPE_MISSING.suggestion: Add dtype field (e.g. float32, int64, video, image, string)

SHAPE_INVALID.message: features.{{key}}.shape must be a non-empty array of positive integers

NAMES_INVALID.suggestion: Set names to a string array or null

NAMES_LENGTH_MISMATCH.message: features.{{key}}.names length ({{actual}}) does not match shape last dim ({{expected}})
NAMES_LENGTH_MISMATCH.suggestion: Make names array length equal to shape last dimension

VIDEO_FPS_MISSING.message: Video feature {{key}} has missing or ≤0 fps; fallback to global info.fps
VIDEO_FPS_MISSING.suggestion: Optional: set fps on this feature explicitly, otherwise info.fps will be used

VIDEO_SHAPE_CHANNELS.message: Video shape channel count is unusual
VIDEO_SHAPE_CHANNELS.suggestion: Typically channels are 3 (RGB); both [C,H,W] and [H,W,C] are supported

VIDEO_SHAPE_NDIM.message: Video shape should be 3D (C, H, W), got {{n}}D

IMAGE_SHAPE_NDIM.message: Image shape should be 3D (C, H, W), got {{n}}D

EPISODES_PARQUET_MISSING.message: meta/episodes first file does not exist

EPISODES_PARQUET_INVALID.message: meta/episodes first file could not be parsed as Parquet
EPISODES_PARQUET_INVALID.suggestion: Ensure episodes Parquet files are valid

DATA_PATH_TEMPLATE.message: info.data_path does not match default template
DATA_PATH_TEMPLATE.suggestion: Use default data path template or keep custom path consistent

VIDEO_PATH_TEMPLATE.message: info.video_path does not match default template

SPLITS_MISSING_TRAIN.suggestion: Add splits with at least "train" key
